snippet.title: WPCA: World Phasebound Control Authority - Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10020541/

"The world does not repeat. Mystery is not defined. Life does not communicate. Chaos is not aligned."
 
Become a Containment Agent of the Seoul Branch of the World Phasebound Control Authority and face bizarrely altered supernatural phenomena.
Enter the containment zone for the eternal safety of humanity.

Coming in 2028. Pre-order now.
